company_summary: Character.ai is a Palo Alto-based startup that creates personal AI platforms for open-ended conversational applications. The company's core product is built on breakthrough research, offering a direct-to-consumer experience, and its founders, Noam Shazeer and Daniel De Freitas, are AI experts who previously worked on Google's LaMDA language model. Character.ai raised $43 million in seed funding in 2021 and recently made news for its innovative approach to chatbots, with one of its founders contributing to a widely-cited paper on the topic. With no recent update on team size, the company continues to develop its conversational AI experiences.
